title:
6.11.24 - Key worker trip 

Last night M and her keyworker went to the Middleton Arena  to experience 'The most haunted' stage show presented by Yvette Fielding and accompanied by the Most Haunted team,  prior to the show they enjoyed tea at the local Wetherspoons where she delved into fish and chips and sticky toffee pudding and custard.
